root_cause: The public locale handler ran in document bubbling phase while the V18 mobile drilldown owns a document capture-phase click handler.
The language option therefore did not own the event ordering and production NL→EN click readback could time out even though href and source runtime were correct.

evidence.repeated_failure: click-driven production verifier timed out waiting for /en/prijzen

prevention: Handle [data-bg-language-option] at window capture phase before document/mobile-menu capture handlers.
Prevent default and stop competing handlers, then explicitly navigate to the canonical localized href.
Rotate the i18n asset version for every public navigation behavior change.
Require live click-driven NL→EN→NL readback before functional green.
